# Image attributions

## Status (2026-08-25)

`hero.jpg` and `ambiance2.jpg` are genuine Gemini generations as of
2026-08-25 (generated via the `gemini-image-generator` tool),
replacing the R-logo placeholder and an anime-collage screenshot
shared with `rp-package-update-workflow`. `ambiance1` is not
referenced in this post's `.qmd` — the slot simply isn't used.

- `hero.jpg`: a stack of graduated wire-mesh sieves, coarse on top and
  finer below, beside a pile of gravel. Metaphor: data passing through
  successive layers of validation, coarse checks first, finer checks
  last.
- `ambiance2.jpg`: three graduated ceramic bowls nested by size with a
  wooden spoon across the largest. Metaphor: layered levels of
  testing, broad and shallow at the base, narrow and deep at the top.

Both processed via `magick -resize 1600x -strip -quality 85` to
1600x873.
